events.title: University of Kansas team creates Lynx
events.summary: Lou Montulli, Michael Grobe, and Charles Rezac at the University of Kansas built Lynx in 1992 — a text-based [hypertext] browser that later gained web support.
events.about: Before graphical browsers dominated, Lynx let developers and universities browse [hypertext] from shell accounts. It remained essential for accessibility and low-bandwidth access for decades.

narrative.whyChosen: Lynx proved [hypertext] worked without graphics — critical for universities on Unix.
narrative.whyImportant: It kept the web accessible on text-only and low-resource systems.
narrative.problemSolved: Many users had no [GUI] but still needed to read linked documents.
